pages.text: After reading about $(l:apotheosis:spawner/stats)Spawner Stats$(), you may be wondering how to change them.$(p)Enter $(9)Spawner Runes$(). Hold a rune and right-click a $(9)Mob Spawner$() to apply it.$(p)Every rune and its effect is visible in JEI under the uses of Mob Spawners.

pages.title: Spawner Chains
pages.text: Runes are forged from $(9)Spawner Chains$(), which drop when a spawner is destroyed by an explosion.$(p)The initial explosion triggers a cascade. A few seconds later it detonates, littering the ground with the stored mob and many chains.

pages.title: Blank Runes
pages.text: Once you have some chains, the first thing you'll need to do is craft some blank $(9)Spawner Runes$().

pages.title: Upgrade Runes
pages.text: There are four core upgrade runes, one for each World Tier above Haven.$(p)These runes modify the core stats: Min/Max Spawn Delay, Spawn Count, Max Entities, and Activation Range.

pages.title: Frontiersman's Rune
pages.text: Each tier rune is crafted around that tier's $(9)Rarity Material$().

pages.title: Wayfarer's Rune
pages.text: The core stat upgrades increase with the rune's tier.

pages.title: Mountaineer's Rune
pages.text: The higher runes require an $(9)Infused Spawner Rune$() and rarer materials.

pages.title: Thundering Rune
pages.text: The final rune will create an unstoppable engine of mob creation.

pages.title: Stat Runes
pages.text: Changing other (non-core) stats requires a rune dedicated to that stat. Each stat has one rune, with the cost depending on how strong the effect is.

pages.title: Spawning Range
pages.text: This rune changes a Spawner's Spawn Range.

pages.title: Control
pages.text: This rune gives a spawner redstone control. The spawner will not operate without a redstone signal.

pages.title: Perpetual Twilight
pages.text: This rune makes the mob spawning process ignore light levels.$(p)Dark mobs can spawn in light, and vice versa.

pages.title: Silence!
pages.text: This rune makes all spawned mobs make no sound.$(p)No hurt noises, no ambient noises, nothing.

pages.title: The Fountain of Youth
pages.text: This rune will cause spawned mobs to be reverted to their infant form.$(p)Assuming they have one, anyway. If they don't, nothing will happen.

pages.title: Burn Them All!
pages.text: This rune causes spawned mobs to be set on fire.$(p)Obviously, this won't work if the mob is immune to fire.

pages.title: Infused Runes
pages.text: Stronger runes need an $(9)Infused Spawner Rune$(), which are created via Infusion Enchanting.

pages.title: Brain Drain
pages.text: This infused rune causes spawned mobs to have no entity AI.$(p)Unlike 'true' no AI mobs, they can still be pushed around.

pages.title: Defying All Logic
pages.text: This infused rune is a direct upgrade to the $(9)Rune of Perpetual Twilight$().$(p)All spawn conditions, including light, will be ignored. Empty space is still required.

pages.title: Alone in the World
pages.text: This infused rune allows the spawner to run without a player nearby.$(p)The mobs might get lonely.

pages.title: Again and Again
pages.text: This infused rune grants Echoing, which causes spawned mobs to drop an additional copy of their loot table.$(p)It can be applied multiple times.

pages.title: Inverting Runes
pages.text: Hold $(9)Nether Quartz$() in your off hand while applying a rune to reverse its effect.$(p)The quartz is not consumed.$(p)Tier runes cannot be inverted.

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Stat runes respect the caps shown in JEI, while tier runes set values directly.$(p)Hold Shift over a spawner item to see its stats.
